messages:
maya (eng-platform): Quick sync — postmortem action sweep for INC-834. Need confirmation on canary window, rollback contingency, and who will update the runbook. Current plan: canary 09/15 14:00 UTC. @owen @liam @nina please ack ownership and ETA.

owen (eng-sre): Ack. I can own the rollback checklist and runbook infra steps. I will draft the checklist and post it by EOD today. Need list of endpoints that are risky.

liam (eng-runtime): I can take canary gating + metric dashboards. Will add scoped routing so we can exclude migration-affected endpoints if needed. ETA tomorrow AM.

nina (product): I will handle stakeholder comms and chair the canary review. I can also own the product acceptance item. ETA: noon tomorrow.

maya (eng-platform): Dependencies note: platform DB migration (PR #428) needs to be merged before full canary. DB team said they might land late today. If that happens we either shift the canary or run a scoped canary. @owen any thoughts?

owen (eng-sre): DB said their merge window is ~22:00 UTC. That's after the planned canary. Options: 1) move canary to 17:00 UTC, 2) keep 14:00 but run scoped canary excluding migration endpoints, 3) postpone full canary. I recommend scoped canary + dry-run of rollback earlier. I'll prepare the rollback dry-run steps.

maya (eng-platform): @nina which do stakeholders prefer — earlier scoped canary or later full canary?

nina (product): Stakeholders prefer earlier so QA can validate during their day. So 15:00 scoped canary is preferable. If DB can't move, we'll proceed scoped.

liam (eng-runtime): Scoped canary is fine. I'll implement header-based routing to exclude migration paths and add a gating check on error rate + latency. Will also add a synthetic to validate.

owen (eng-sre): I'll add a trace tag "inc834_canary" and a grep filter in tracing so we can quickly verify regressions. Also dropped a rollback checklist draft in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/INC-834 (please review).

maya (eng-platform): Action summary:
- Rollback checklist + runbook infra steps -> @owen (EOD today)
- Scoped canary gating + routing -> @liam (tomorrow AM)
- Stakeholder comms + canary review -> @nina (tomorrow noon)
- Runbook merge + dry-run -> @owen + @maya (target today 17:00)
If DB merges late, use scoped canary. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own your item.

oncall-bot: Reminder: INC-834 action deadlines are tracked — next checkpoint 1694860000 UTC. 

maya (eng-platform): Good — thanks everyone. I'll update the incident notes with this plan and tag the DB team for a final merge confirmation.

liam (eng-runtime): Quick FYI — I'll post the scoped canary config in the canary repo once the routing PR is ready, pinging here when it's live.

owen (eng-sre): Read and acked. Will post the rollback dry-run results in the doc when complete.

nina (product): Acknowledged. I'll send the calendar invite for the canary review and include a short acceptance checklist.
